# ABP News Live

> > ABP News Live delivers breaking news, business analysis, and regional coverage across India with focus on corporate earnings, politics, and social issues.

ABP News Live is a leading Indian news platform providing comprehensive coverage of national and regional stories, with strong emphasis on business developments (particularly Reliance Industries, Jio), state-level politics (especially Andhra Pradesh), automotive trends, and personal finance guidance.

## Key Topics

- Reliance Industries & Jio
- Andhra Pradesh Politics
- Electric Vehicles & Automotive
- Quarterly Earnings & Financial Performance
- Personal Finance & Money Savings
- Communal Issues & Social Tensions
- Indian Market Analysis
- Mukesh Ambani & Corporate Leaders
- Fuel Prices & Energy
- Regional News Coverage
- Supreme Court & Legal Matters
- COVID-19 Impact
- Brand Analysis & Market Trends
- Kurnool & Regional Cities
